description: Cross-microservice research and planning across multiple repositories, with findings saved to Obsidian. Use when the user asks to investigate, research, plan, understand, or trace functionality across multiple services or repos. Triggers on: "research across services", "find how X works across repos", "trace the flow from service A to B", "plan a feature that touches multiple services", "cross-service", "cross-ms", "how do these services communicate", "find where X is implemented", "compare implementations across services", or any task requiring read-only exploration of multiple repositories. Saves structured research output to Obsidian vault using the obsidian CLI.
